name: Rally
description: The pivot from reactive to predictive. A pre-created event — 25,000 expected attendees, tomorrow 16:00-20:00, J1<->J2 affected with one closure — run through the real Phase 4 what-if SUMO prediction, then approved and published as a citizen advisory.

pre_seeded_event.note: starts_at/ends_at are deliberately left as a relative template ('tomorrow 16:00-20:00', matching the checklist's own SN-131 wording) rather than a baked absolute timestamp — a hardcoded past date would silently go stale and misrepresent the event as historic on every rehearsal after the day it was written. The presenter (or run-book automation) substitutes the real current date at demo time. affected_links/closure_links are real corridor edge ids from shared/corridor_topology.py, matching the same J1<->J2 link referenced in SN-131.
